integrity: The theorem is supported by a full direct algebraic proof and supplementary finite numerical checks. The result is not attributed to any independent certifier and has not undergone external validation.
scientific_limitations: Uniform-spoke weighted wheel shortest-path metrics only: integer rim size at least four, rim length one, spoke length between one half and one. No claim for nonuniform radial weights, other geometric regimes, or nonlinear/distorted embedding targets. Equivalent prior results under unfamiliar nomenclature cannot be ruled out with absolute certainty.
title: Optimal spoke lengths and a two-mode Hilbert-snowflake transition for weighted wheels
